run_scenario: run a Gaia2 scenario inside a container and return the graded result dict
extract_message_text: extract plain text from a message that may be a string, dict with content blocks, or error object
extract_response_from_events: parse JSONL event lines and return the last send_message_to_user content
extract_user_task: extract the user task string from scenario event data supporting current and legacy formats
build_container_env: build container environment variables including judge model, provider, and API key configuration
